items.note: Says exports can reach about 2 million rows, so memory matters, and the fix must not load all rows or build the output in memory.
The signature export_orders_csv(db, path) must stay the same because three callers use it.
Gives the header and column order: id,customer_name,total,created_at.
Says not to add dependencies and to ask before adding any.
Names the per-row customer lookup (N+1 query) as the main cause, as the person reported.
Requires each row to be written to the file as it is produced, not built into one big string.
Says customer names can contain commas, so every value must be properly CSV-quoted.
Requires running the existing tests in tests/test_export.py.
Asks for a minimal change and says not to restructure the module.
